name: Demiurgus
bio: Demiurgus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors gives no date for the poet.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 52).

poems.title: Book VII, 52
poems.author: Demiurgus
poems.text: I hold Hesiod of Ascra, the glory of spacious Hellas and the ornament of Poesy.
